create.prompt: Primary request: Use case: animation motion reference for a tiny game sprite. Primary request: animate the referenced orange cat walking naturally from left to right in a clean side profile. Subject: the same small orange quadruped cat silhouette and palette as the input reference, with orange fur only; no hoodie, no shirt, no clothing, no accessories. Action: a clear four-beat walk cycle with alternating front and rear legs, visible paw lift and plant, slight natural body weight shift, steady head and tail, then continue walking left to right. Camera: locked-off side-on camera, full body always visible, no zoom, no cuts, no rotation, plain light background. Style/format: clean stylized pixel-art motion reference, preserve the simple chunky silhouette and colors from the reference, no realistic anatomy changes. Timing/beats: show at least two complete walk cycles; make the leg movement obvious and readable. Constraints: remain a four-legged cat for the entire clip, side view facing right, keep all four paws attached to the body, no standing upright, no hopping, no human gait, no extra limbs. Avoid: orange clothing, hoodie, costume, text, camera movement, duplicate cats, morphing, flicker, jitter, floating paws.
